page_title: LAZ 0-2 INT | Lazio v Inter 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
90+2' The resulting corner from Kristjan Asllani (Inter) is cleared by the defence.

90+1' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Ivan Provedel pulls off a brilliant save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Hakan Calhanoglu will be replaced by Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
89' Here's the change. Lautaro Martinez leaves the pitch and Davy Klaassen (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
87' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) probably spoke out of turn to the referee and is sent off for dissent.
85' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Now Lazio have a corner.
81' Nicolo Casale (Lazio) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Felipe Anderson leaves the pitch and Taty Castellanos (Lazio) comes on.
78' Substitution. Marcus Thuram is replaced by Marko Arnautovic (Inter).
75' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Nicolo Rovella and he is replaced by Danilo Cataldi (Lazio).
75' Substitution. Mattia Zaccagni makes way for Pedro (Lazio).

71' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper.
70' Substitution. Davide Frattesi (Inter) has come on for Nicolo Barella.
70' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Federico Dimarco is replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
66' 0 - 2 Goal! Marcus Thuram (Inter) takes a short pass from Nicolo Barella in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
65' Daichi Kamada will be replaced by Luis Alberto (Lazio).
61' Nicolo Barella (Inter) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
56' A rebound falls at the feet of Daichi Kamada (Lazio) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
54' Inter hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
49' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
49' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Lazio.

48' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save. Lazio force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The resulting corner from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
45+2' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Federico Dimarco (Inter). Inter earn a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
43' The ball is cleared after Marcus Thuram (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Inter.
40' 0 - 1 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 0:1.
39' A clumsy foul by Adam Marusic (Lazio) and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle. Inter will take a free kick near the side line.
37' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is able to continue to play.
36' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.

35' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
33' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

32' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner.

30' Marcus Thuram (Inter) holds his head in his hands after missing a big chance. He latches on to a rebound, creates some space from himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
28' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) beats his man to the lofted pass, but his header sails harmlessly well wide of the right post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
26' Yellow card. Marcus Thuram (Inter) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
20' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.
19' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) commits a rough foul. Fabio Maresca stops the game and makes a call. Inter are awarded a free kick.
17' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
17' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. It will be a corner kick for Lazio.
13' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
13' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Lazio have a corner.
11' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

11' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
5' A dangerous looking corner kick from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared to safety by the defence. Corner kick. Inter will have an opportunity.

4' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Marcus Thuram (Inter). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The linesman points to the corner flag, Inter are going to take it.
4' Inter are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
1' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
Lazio will kick-off.
Fabio Maresca will supervise the game today.
